subject: Clarion trial extension: flex-band credit vs. fixed extra week
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clarionhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Max Torres <max.torres@clarionhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Clarion trial extension: burn rate spike + ask

Hi Chloe —

Thanks again for running the Clarion evaluation last week. We pushed a heavier job mix (longer sequences + reranking flow) and saw an unexpected burn spike on day three that ate through our allocated runway faster than we planned. The engineering team wants another 3 business days to finish the last integration tests, and Product would like a short runway to validate the final metrics (latency p95 and cost per inference).

Two asks: can Redwood extend the trial by 3 business days (no change to the existing PO) or, alternatively, allocate a small top-up of tokens/credits we can draw down? If we go with top-up, can we get a price concession (we are evaluating committed purchase levels post-POC) — even a modest discount on the add-on would help.

I've attached the snapshot of the test run and a rough burn estimate. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Sr. PM, Clarion Health
ellen.park@clarionhealth.com
+1 617-555-0142

[Attachment: Clarion_POC_metrics_snapshot.png]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clarionhealth.com>, Max Torres <max.torres@clarionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarion trial extension: burn rate spike + ask

Hi Ellen —

Appreciate the detail and the attachment. First, totally reasonable ask. We have two practical paths that are both quick for procurement:

1) 3 business day time-box extension of the existing trial window (no invoice change) — we can do that immediately and push the trial end-date out by 3 business days. This keeps accounting simple but doesn’t add credits for bursty consumption.

2) Small top-up in credits (token bucket) that you draw from; we can apply a 15% discount on that one-off top-up if Clarion confirms an intent to move to a committed quarterly package within 30 days (simple written confirmation is fine). The top-up approach preserves the trial end-date but gives you extra headroom for the final runs and is better if you want strict accounting of consumption.

Operational note: given the pattern you shared, I recommend enabling prefix K+V caching for the reranking calls during the final runs — that usually reduces token spend significantly for repeated prompts. Priyom can share a one-click config snippet.

Which would you prefer? If you want option 2, I can route the discount approval now (no legal changes). If option 1, I’ll update the trial window today.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

[Attachment referenced: estimated-burn.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clarionhealth.com>, Max Torres <max.torres@clarionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarion trial extension: burn rate spike + ask

Looping in Karthik for pricing and Priyom for engineering config — small corrections: (1) I can approve up to 20% discount on a single top-up (not 15) if Clarion is willing to sign an "intent to buy" doc (non-binding; just a note of intent + expected committed spend band) and (2) if Clarion routes to dedicated threading for a few test jobs we can give you a burst SLA for the extra runs (latency guardrails) for the extension period. That SLA would be temporary but explicit.

If they prefer the pure time extension (no credits), confirm and we’ll flip the dates. If they want the top-up, say how many estimated tokens you want and we’ll create a small invoice with the 20% discount applied.

-karthik
Director, Sales Engineering
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

On a separate note Priyom — can you share the caching snippet and a quick checklist for the Clarion infra team (GPU batch sizing and KV cache setting) so they can implement before the extra runs?

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clarionhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Max Torres <max.torres@clarionhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarion trial extension: burn rate spike + ask

Hi team —

Thanks — Clarion will take option 2 (top-up credits) and we'd like the 20% concession. Estimated top-up: 120k token-equivalent (spread over the 3 business days). We will send an internal note of intent to buy (non-binding) to Chloe by EOD. Please proceed with an invoice and the one-click caching snippet; our infra lead (cc'ed) will implement the cache later today.

Ellen
Sr. PM, Clarion Health
